Cinematic 16:9 wide still in a modern social-first coastal commercial look, tactile editorial energy, clean true-to-life color with crisp whites, slightly warm highlights, and airy lifted shadows. SCARLETT (Image 1) wears a black long-sleeve rash vest as a swim top and simple flip-flops, a faded tote slung over one shoulder, caught mid-stride on the walkway with weight still committed forward, unfussy posture, the lived-in coral mouth unblotted as she has not yet turned fully toward her companion. MAISIE (Image 2) wears a spring suit peeled to the waist so the neoprene torso hangs around her hips over a swimsuit top, simple beach slides on her feet, a foam rental-style surfboard tucked hard under one arm, just falling in beside SCARLETT (Image 1), torso angled in, already mid-grin, the look locked on that coral mouth as if she has only just clocked it. Broad pale-concrete Bondi promenade running above the sand, a simple metal safety rail opening onto the ocean and incoming sets, a rack of bright rental surfboards lined at the walkway edge, joggers receding along the path in soft background blur, low commercial beach infrastructure, open morning sky, foam-white board flashing against sun-bleached neutrals and ocean blue-green. High-key even morning coastal daylight, bright and slightly harsh, pale concrete bouncing fill, clean directional shadows, sun glancing off neoprene and the metal rail. Wide eye-level promenade commercial frame with a naturalistic handheld freeze, enough depth to hold both women, the board rack, and the rail while the distant water goes softly atmospheric.
